relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.evidence: He earned his doctorate at the University of Utrecht for an edition of the text of Daśabhûmikasûtra (1926).

relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit, Avestan, Old Persian and principles of Indo-Germanic linguistics
relations.evidence: he was appointed Professor of Sanskrit, Avestan, Old Persian and principles of Indo-Germanic linguistics at the University of Utrecht (1930).

relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.evidence: professor of Japanese at the University of Leiden (1931–1946)

relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.evidence: joined the faculty at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, where he had been a visiting professor during 1937–1938.

relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.evidence: In 1946 he resigned from his post at Leiden, and joined the faculty at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa

relations.subject: Johannes Rahder
relations.evidence: The following year he went to Yale University, where he was Professor of Japanese from 1947 until his retirement in 1965.
